name: BusinessFlow AI - Agentic RAG Internal Test Gateway (Adapted from 4827)

parameters.content:
OPTIONAL INTERNAL TEST GATEWAY ONLY. The production chat UI must call Fastify directly.
The Fastify API owns authentication, tenant permissions, persistence, LangGraph execution, evidence validation, consent and idempotency.
Configure BOTH Header Auth credentials after import. The backend URL is a proposed contract, not a verified existing route.
Do not expose the webhook publicly; do not upload file bytes or secrets here.
No WhatsApp, MongoDB, LLM, or short memory lives in n8n.
